description: Change a title's or caption's text, or restyle many at once (clip_ids, or every one on track_id). The style is merged; null turns an outline, shadow, box or highlight off (and max_lines back to all lines). spans (one clip) restyle part of its text. Fonts: video://catalog/fonts, or an unknown font is refused with the close matches. Returns the new timeline_id (edit that one next), what changed, and where each changed clip now sits.

color.description: #RRGGBB, or #RRGGBBAA where AA is opacity (00 clear, FF solid)

anchor.description: Which edge of the text sits on y (titles default middle, captions bottom)

#RRGGBB, or #RRGGBBAA where AA is opacity (00 clear, FF solid)

font.description: Installed: Inter, Montserrat, Open Sans, Lato, Bebas Neue, Lobster Two, Comic Neue, Fira Code, DejaVu Sans, Serif and Mono, Noto for most scripts (video://catalog/fonts lists all); another font: font_media_id

color.description: #RRGGBB, or #RRGGBBAA where AA is opacity (00 clear, FF solid)

mode.description: Needs caption word timings. karaoke: each word takes color as it is spoken and keeps it; fill: likewise, sweeping across each word; word: only the word being spoken; pop: that word, growing a little

max_lines.description: At most this many lines at once: longer text shows in turn, a screenful at a time, each from its first word (by word timing, or by length without it). Lines are broken here, by the font, balanced in length; null shows it all at once

max_width.description: Of frame width: longer text wraps onto more lines, balanced in length

color.description: #RRGGBB, or #RRGGBBAA where AA is opacity (00 clear, FF solid)
#RRGGBB, or #RRGGBBAA where AA is opacity (00 clear, FF solid)

x.description: Of frame width, 0 = left: where the text sits, by its align side

y.description: Of frame height, 0 = top: where the anchor edge of the text sits

preview.description: inline: image in the result; link: URI that renders on read; none

anyOf.description: Style part of the text: each span restyles words first_word to last_word (from 0: the timed words, or the text split at spaces), e.g. one word in yellow

spans.description: Only with a single clip: replaces its spans (null removes them). New text drops spans it doesn't give

style.description: Merged into each clip's style; null fields reset

timeline_id.description: Timeline handle; every edit returns a new one

track_id.description: Instead of clip_ids: every title and caption on a track

name: text.set

changed.description: What the edit added, removed or modified; a clip or transition says its track and where it now sits (frames, end exclusive)

clip_id.description: The clip this edit made or acted on (each tool says which)

clip_ids.description: Every clip this edit made or acted on, linked ones included (each tool says which)

parent.description: The version this edit started from

frames.description: Frames shown; for a waveform, the start and end of its span

loudness.description: Measured for audio edits, over the waveform span

timeline_id.description: The new version: edit this one next (older ids stay valid)

title: Set text
